answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Sybil swarms face exponential capital exhaustion: registering identities requires staking collateral that scales superlinearly as $C(n) = k \cdot 2^n$. Just as basalt bedrock resists erosion, this mechanism withstands attacks. A rogue cluster spanning an ocean of fake nodes expends ruinous wealth, making identity forgery leave a telltale economic pigment across the ledger.
